work_order_description: Workflow TD corrective work order for ep01_shot01. Derived from accepted corrective_plan.json actions wd-001 through wd-004. All items required before controlled retry authorization.
issue_summary: Retry #2 frames rejected due to extremely low visual quality and character identity instability. Primary cause identified as model/checkpoint incompatibility (realvisxlV50_v50Bakedvae.safetensors) and insufficient identity preservation in current workflow.

corrective_tasks.description: Evaluate alternative checkpoint options recommended by Character Director for workflow compatibility. Test that the alternative checkpoint(s) can be loaded and executed within the current ComfyUI workflow structure. Document compatibility findings.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Compatibility report listing tested checkpoints, workflow load status, and recommended checkpoint for retry

corrective_tasks.description: Review and recommend changes to reference_locked workflow parameters affecting identity strength: denoising strength, guidance scale, reference image weighting, and any sampler/scheduler settings. Document current values and proposed revision values.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Parameter change specification listing current vs. proposed values with rationale for each change

corrective_tasks.description: Evaluate identity preservation components present in or compatible with current architecture: IP-Adapter, LoRA, reference lock, or stronger reference weighting mechanisms. Determine which components should be added or adjusted to prevent identity drift.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Evaluation report of available identity preservation components with enable/disable recommendations and configuration values

corrective_tasks.description: Define complete workflow revision requirements before retry: new checkpoint path, revised parameter values, identity preservation configuration, and any structural workflow changes needed. This constitutes the Workflow TD sign-off specification for retry authorization.
corrective_tasks.completion_criteria: Complete workflow revision specification document ready for controlled retry authorization review

joint_gate_dependency.description: Workflow TD work order must be completed and reviewed before controlled retry can be authorized. Retry remains blocked until joint-001 (corrective_plan_approval) gate is cleared by both Character Director and Workflow TD.
joint_gate_dependency.retry_authorized_by: joint approval of both role work orders
